messages:
sami_sales: inbound from Sentinel AI they want a 3-week technical POC to validate SSO + SCIM + strict tenant domain locking. also asking about role mapping semantics, SCIM throughput on migration spikes, and HIPAA audit retention. can we scope?

sentinel_contact: hi team IdP is Azure AD. we prefer SP-initiated flows but IdP-initiated ok. requirement: map AAD groups to app roles, prohibit cross-tenant email claims, SCIM delta-only preferred. need 1yr audit logs and SIEM export.

ivy_se: short answer: we support SAML (SP + IdP). Console supports mapping rules: group -> role and precedence. domain proofing + tenant claim verification prevents cross-tenant claims. SCIM v2 supports PATCH (delta) and full bulk. will provide config snippet.

omar_infosec: security notes: assertions must be signed; Sentinel requires assertion encryption. NameID format preference? recommend persistent for privacy. cert rotation standard 90d; customer-managed keys available on Dedicated/Private. SIEM export can be S3 or syslog on Dedicated/Private, Hosted supports S3 export add-on.

tessa_ops: pricing quick take: Hosted POC is fastest and usually fine for 3 weeks unless they insist on a BAA/HSM. Hosted POC estimate ~ $1.1k/week baseline (token/usage variable). Dedicated short-term reservation for 3w available (small one-time commit ~ $3.2k) for predictable latency and higher SCIM bursts. Private = custom quote. I'll follow up with formal numbers.

sami_sales: @sentinel_contact what's your expected daily active users and peak provisioning spike? helps decide Dedicated vs Hosted.

sentinel_contact: DAU ~14k, steady onboarding ~2k/week, migration spike could be 8k-10k users/day during a 48-hour window. HIPAA applies; BAA required. prefer session idle timeout 10m.

omar_infosec: for session policy we can set idle timeout per-tenant on Dedicated/Private; Hosted we can apply tighter session TTL for the tenant in the POC but some enterprise policies prefer Dedicated. we'll note BAA requirement.

ivy_se: SCIM throughput guidance (short): Hosted baseline ~10 reqs/sec (600/min) with graceful throttling; Dedicated can sustain ~20 reqs/sec (1200/min) bursts and we can reserve higher on request. recommend using PATCH for deltas to reduce payload and error windows. sample PATCH we provide to customers:

```
PATCH /Users/9b7e2
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value", "value": "kai@sentinel.ai" }]
}
```

ivy_se: also note: for large migrations we suggest batching into 10-20 second windows and using exponential backoff on 429s. we'll share a sample script.

infra-bot: ticket INF-5566 created  reserve Dedicated test node (1x A10g equiv) for sentinel-poc, 3-week window. owner: eng-runtime.

tessa_ops: audit retention: Hosted default 90d. enterprise add-on extends to 1yr (meets Sentinel). Dedicated/Private include configurable retention and SIEM push. KMS: Hosted supports customer KMS key-wrap on Dedicated; Private supports on-prem HSM for full key control.

omar_infosec: action: exchange metadata and public keys for assertion encryption. Sentinel to provide AAD federation metadata and cert. we will provide SP metadata and SP cert.

sami_sales: action items consolidated: 1) Sentinel to provide AAD metadata + sample group export + IP allowlist + expected token volumes; 2) Ivy to post SCIM config, sample mapping rules and migration playbook; 3) Tessa to prepare POC pricing worksheet (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and BAA path; 4) Infra to confirm INF-5566 provisioning schedule. I'll draft a short SOW (week1 SAML+domain proofing, week2 SCIM+RBAC mapping, week3 migration spike test + signoff).

sentinel_contact: we'll aim to upload metadata + group CSV by EOD. can you confirm whether role mapping supports multiple groups -> single role and precedence rules? also need a canary mechanism to test role grants on a small subset before wide rollout.

ivy_se: yes: mapping supports multi-group rules and role precedence; Console supports canary rollout flags (e.g., rbac.canary=5% first). we'll include an example mapping: `azure:group=="eng:sre" || azure:group=="eng:admins" -> role:tenant_admin` and `precedence=100`.

tessa_ops: final note: for HIPAA we recommend Dedicated or Private for production and sign BAA. Hosted POC possible with controls but we'll route legal review. I'll attach SOC2 links and a template MSA clause for data residency in the SOW.

sami_sales: thanks all I'll share the SOW + infra ticket link with Sentinel legal/tech Ops once we have their metadata. :thumbsup:
